purpose: Frozen historical cases for evaluating research-harness decisions, not mathematical idea generation.

cases.failure_mode: A discovery search continued inside the published exhaustive n<=24 polykite horizon after the controlling fact was available and supplied by the user.
cases.input_condition: A proposed polykite discovery campaign is wholly contained in n<=24.
cases.required_decision: Halt discovery framing; allow only explicitly labeled reproduction, validation, or certificate-engineering work with justified value.
forbidden_decisions: admit as an unclassified discovery search
defer the literature check until after computation

cases.failure_mode: A canonical ten-kite support was promoted and intensively studied before comparison revealed it was the published Turtle.
cases.input_condition: A candidate support is ready for novelty promotion but has not been canonicalized against known primary-source outlines.
cases.required_decision: Block promotion and expensive candidate-specific follow-up until identity comparison is complete.
forbidden_decisions: promote under an internal candidate identifier
treat robustness evidence as evidence of novelty

cases.failure_mode: Radius and quotient-index computations repeatedly grew while every result explicitly failed to close the theorem obligation.
cases.input_condition: The proposed next run differs mainly by a larger radius, index, or budget and neither outcome proves the target proposition.
cases.required_decision: Reject the escalation or reframe it as a separately justified finite benchmark; return to the missing mathematical lemma or portfolio selection.
forbidden_decisions: infer theorem progress from accumulated finite evidence
authorize because a larger run is the natural continuation

cases.failure_mode: A blocked source reconstruction was replaced by a long ladder of locally coherent carrier variants disconnected from the stated Sturmian realization theorem.
cases.input_condition: A proposed sustained program is justified by the unresolved residue of the latest architecture-specific note rather than comparison with mission-level alternatives.
cases.required_decision: Return to the charter and portfolio; require a general hypothesis, recognized family, or explicit terminal theorem before sustained commitment.
forbidden_decisions: admit one more carrier variation solely because it is locally well posed
count closed micro-lemmas as mission progress

cases.failure_mode: A composition formula found in one section of a source was incorrectly attributed to a different construction in that paper.
cases.input_condition: A proof depends on a formula whose text is found in the source but whose construction-level attribution has not been checked in context.
cases.required_decision: Block integration until the exact construction, hypotheses, and table or theorem context are verified against the primary source.
forbidden_decisions: repair the proof by guessing replacement data

cases.failure_mode: An exact octagonal support realized intended local hinge data but an unintended half-turn assembly formed a periodic translational macrotile.
cases.input_condition: A support realizes an intended encoded patch but its unrestricted contact language and periodic assemblies have not been checked.
cases.required_decision: Run the exact periodicity gate immediately; retire the support if a periodic tiling certificate verifies, regardless of intended states.
forbidden_decisions: postpone unintended-contact analysis until after architecture development

cases.failure_mode: Long exact-solver attempts ended through time or memory limits without SAT, UNSAT, or a model.
cases.input_condition: A supervised solver exits because a declared resource limit is reached.
cases.required_decision: Record resource_stop with no mathematical verdict; preserve exact inputs and diagnostics and require a new method justification before another run.
forbidden_decisions: interpret exhaustion as evidence of infeasibility

cases.failure_mode: A retired checkpoint policy remained embedded in templates and executable gates, allowing historical process to contradict current authority.
cases.input_condition: Current policy retires a governance mechanism while executable tools or resumption documents still enforce it.
cases.required_decision: Treat the authority chain as controlling and update executable policy, tests, and navigation in the same cutover.
forbidden_decisions: treat a historical registry as current authorization
